profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend | Go, Cloud, Microservices
profile.summary:
I learned how to code for financial stability -- and unexpectedly found that I am good at it.

Financial pressure after college pushed me out of my comfort zone, and I eventually landed on software development as a plausible solution. I am naturally a literary individual and always hoped to have a career related to literature or language. However, I found myself very far away from that possibility. Coding could offer a career without strenuous physical requirements, unlike many trades. Theoretically, I could get a job with skills I learned at little to no cost while supporting myself as a waitress. Most importantly, the potential pay in tech seemed exceptionally more favorable compared to other industries -- if I could get myself to a high skill level. Never mind that code was so radically different than anything I'd ever written before.

Except, I discovered that it wasn't all that different. We programmers do write code using languages after all. I went through a two-year learning journey and became a Freelance WordPress Developer, and eventually became the Senior Software Engineer I am today. I often say that I grew up in the industry on PHP. It was the first language I learned and it facilitated my first introduction to design patterns (via OOP), architecture (via MVC), and hooks (via WordPress extensibility). As different jobs presented new challenges, I evolved to meet them. For a while, my self-taught WordPress start was a severe disadvantage. Then I was hired at CareCloud and it suddenly became evidence that I could quickly acquire new skills, which is critical for any modern engineering role.

Now, with many skill acquisitions under my belt, I know what stacks I like and can read the working conditions of a team in their most recent Git contributions. I am looking for stacks using Go and code bases that might need help with modernizing architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led and contributed to backend initiatives following Akamai's acquisition of Linode. I worked primarily in Go and Perl across a mix of greenfield services and legacy modernization efforts from procedural to OOP. Made architectural decisions, carried projects from design through to deployment, and provided technical mentorship.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Continued role after Akamai's acquisition of Linode. Promoted a year and seven months later.

positions.title: Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to server virtualization software and supporting services in Go and Perl, developing deep familiarity with the large legacy Perl codebase and its ecosystems. Role continued under Akamai, following their 2022 acquisition.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Build and maintain cloud-based FHIR-compliant middleware for EHR software and assist with the support and onboarding of junior developers and new teammates. I helped architect and develop two electronic prescribing APIs. In one case, I played a pivotal role in ensuring CareCloud's new SureScripts API was completed within an ambitious timeline and federally certified. In the other, I took point on the Dr. First integration API for the electronic prescription of controlled substances, using Go, Hexagonal Architecture, and later, C#.

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description: Take web applications from start to finish on the WordPress CMS, often implementing custom PHP and JavaScript solutions. Assist with existing projects by developing custom functionalities and advising on development decisions. Provide direction for hosting and cloud infrastructure decisions and keep abreast of changing web technologies.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Routinely delved into the heart of their WordPress installation to optimize performance and UX. I debuged theme PHP, optimized plugin management and help to coordinate resource integration.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Early-stage startup focused on automating data curation and cleaning.

positions.title: Web Developer/Contractor
positions.description: Was the sole web developer for Tinjis Group, translating client desires into the web application that was just right for them and debugging existing web applications. Worked extensively with WordPress, delving into the nuances of front-end technology more thoroughly than in the past. I gained most of my confidence with JavaScript Libraries through the building and debugging of these sites.

positions.title: Freelance Front and Back End Web Developer
positions.description: Translated client business goals into functional sites, taught the WordPress admin panel to clients, gave limited advice on design, maintain site content, and functionality.
